title: View and Manage AP/AR Data works independently of See Financial Data
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with See Financial Data ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF (like the Service Advisor role).
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and check whether prices are shown.
  2. Open a customer and check for the AP/AR tabs.
custom_expected:
Prices are shown on the work order.

The AP/AR tabs are hidden on the customer.

The two toggles work independently.
evidence: UI: See Financial Data and View and Manage AP/AR Data are separate Cross-Cutting Toggles (both present independently alongside View History Logs); AP/AR is not tied to SFD in the editor.
